text:
ara: heads up — bringing up customer Juno's LoRA finetune merged onto our int4-quant base for a quick smoke. ran the quick-eval pack (juno_quickpack_v1) and seeing a small but consistent quality dip on multi-turn extraction tasks. can people eyeball?

maria: sharing the eval summary, thx.

ara: pasted results below. not blocked but want triage before canary.

maria: quick notes: tokenizer mapping between their fine-tune and our int4 variant might be off for a handful of special tokens. saw token id shifts in the first 5 tokens for ~6% of examples.

aj: can you paste the command you used to run the pack? i'll try reproduce locally against the dedicated pool.

ara: command i used:
```
./run_eval.sh --model redwood/int4-base --adapter juno_lora_v2 --pack juno_quickpack_v1 --batch 16 --quant int4 --output /tmp/juno_eval.json
```

leo: raw numbers from /tmp/juno_eval.json (summary):
- baseline (int4-base + no adapter): EM=62.1%, ROUGE-L=68.5, avg_perplexity=12.4, avg_token_latency=42ms
- merged (int4-base + juno_lora_v2): EM=59.4%, ROUGE-L=66.9, avg_perplexity=13.7, avg_token_latency=48ms
- sample failure rate (exact_match drop) concentrated on multi-turn extraction and table parsing prompts (~3.8% absolute regressed)

zhen: that latency regression + perf hit is weird — adapter shouldn't increase runtime that much unless KV cache alignment is off or we lost some kernel fusion due to shape/pad changes. any logs on KV reuse?

ara: here's a snippet from the eval log where we see extra cache misses:
```
[2024-11-03T09:20:12Z] request_id=... stage=decode step=4 kv_hit=false cache_len_before=0 cache_len_after=0
[2024-11-03T09:20:12Z] request_id=... stage=decode step=5 kv_hit=false cache_len_before=0 cache_len_after=0
```

maria: i also ran a tokenized-diff on a failing example, looks like the adapter injects an extra start token for table headers: token ids differ at positions [0,1,4]. attaching short diff: `orig: [154,2,7,19] vs merged: [154,999,2,7,19]`

aj: ok repro locally. when i load juno_lora_v2 with our int4 loader i see a stray special token mapped to 999. looks like their finetune used an added sentinel during training. we can try two paths: (1) strip sentinel at load time (fast), (2) ask customer to re-export without sentinel (clean).

leo: for short term can we add a tokenizer-compat shim in the adapter loader? patch idea: map unknown sentinel ids to existing pad/ctl token (config flag). i'll try a small branch and run smoke.

deploy-bot: auto-tests for commit redwood/eng-ml#fix/juno-token-shim triggered. 6/7 checks passed, integration-load-test failed (flaky). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

zhen: also worth checking quantization packing — if adapter changes weight layout slightly the int4 kernel selector may fall back to slower implementation. can we capture kernel selection logs?

ara: yes i captured kernel selector for one of the slow traces: `kernel=matmul_int4_generic` (fallback), baseline used `matmul_int4_fused`.

leo: that explains perf. adapter merge changed layer ordering (small reshape) that disabled fused path. i can try to emit a small transform that preserves expected shapes.

aj: proposed next steps:
1) short-term: token-shim in loader + adapter load flag and quick rollback plan if regressions persist.
2) perf: reproduce a minimal model+adapter pair that hits fused vs generic kernels and add unit test to catch it.
3) long-term: add a preflight that checks sentinel/token diffs and kernel selection delta before merging to the hosted catalog.

maria: agree. i'm updating the quick-eval pack to include a token-diff check and a kernel-selection check so future merges fail fast. patch incoming.

ara: thanks all. can we aim to have a patched adapter loader and a follow-up smoke by EOD PST? if both green i'll promote to canary (10% traffic).

leo: working on the loader shim now, will post branch and perf numbers shortly.

deploy-bot: canary rollout blocked: quality-regression-gate failed for juno_quickpack_v1 (EM drop > 2%). See: https://console.redwood.internal/rollouts/6789

ara: noted. will wait for loader shim and perf patch. :thumbsup:

aj: local smoke after shim: EM=62.0%, ROUGE-L=68.3, avg_token_latency=44ms — most regression recovered. pushing branch for review.

maria: merged quick-eval updates to main, new pack run queued.

ara: great. once the CI run finishes and we get green on the updated quickpack, i'll trigger canary. thanks team.

leo: leaving a short TODO in thread: add unit test for kernel-selection parity and token-shim integration test.

ara: closing the loop later with customer Juno and ops.
